_comment: HOB IP / property watermarks. Each reel belongs to ONE IP; its transparent PNG is laid over the whole video (both story and brand modes). This is HOB's own property branding — separate from a brand-collab advertiser logo. To add/rename an IP: edit this map and drop a matching transparent PNG into deploy/watermarks/. Recommended PNG: full-frame at the reel resolution (1080x1920 portrait) with transparency everywhere except the mark.
